The device's certificate is an SVID leaf: one URI SAN, not a CA

name: Real device — a deployment is added and withdrawn
description: The mock WFM adds a deployment to the desired state and later withdraws it. The device reads each new manifest and reports the status of that deployment after each change.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: add deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e01 to the desired state
The device reads the new manifest
The device reports status for the added deployment with the new manifest version
Mock WFM: withdraw deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e01 from the desired state
The device reports the withdrawn deployment as removing or removed

name: Real device — a manifest version that does not increase is rejected
description: The mock WFM serves a changed manifest whose manifestVersion is 1, not greater than the version the device has adopted. The device must reject it and keep its state.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: assign deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e02 in a manifest the device must reject
The device does not act on the rejected manifest (no status report for its new deployment)
The device keeps its previous state (it does not send the ETag of the rejected manifest back)
Mock WFM: restore the default desired state

name: Real device — an unsupported digest algorithm is rejected
description: The mock WFM serves a manifest whose digests use sha512. The device must treat the manifest as invalid, stop processing it and keep its state.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: assign deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e03 in a manifest the device must reject
The device does not act on the rejected manifest (no status report for its new deployment)
The device does not fetch anything by a digest of the unsupported algorithm
The device keeps its previous state (it does not send the ETag of the rejected manifest back)
Mock WFM: restore the default desired state

name: Real device — a bundle that does not match its digest is rejected
description: The mock WFM serves a correct manifest, but the bundle archive it delivers does not hash to the bundle digest. A device that downloads the bundle must abort the update and keep its previous state.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: assign deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e04 in a manifest the device must reject
The device does not act on the rejected manifest (no status report for its new deployment)

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not download the bundle archive, so it was not faced with content that does not match the digest

steps.name: The device keeps its previous state (it does not send the ETag of the rejected manifest back)

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not download the bundle archive, so it was not faced with content that does not match the digest

steps.name: Mock WFM: restore the default desired state

name: Real device — a deployment file that does not match its digest is rejected
description: The mock WFM serves a correct manifest, but the deployment files it delivers do not hash to their digests. A device that downloads the file of the new deployment must abort the update and keep its previous state.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: assign deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e05 in a manifest the device must reject
The device does not act on the rejected manifest (no status report for its new deployment)

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not download this deployment file on its own (it used the bundle), so it was not faced with content that does not match the digest

steps.name: The device keeps its previous state (it does not send the ETag of the rejected manifest back)

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not download this deployment file on its own (it used the bundle), so it was not faced with content that does not match the digest

steps.name: Mock WFM: restore the default desired state

name: Real device — sizeBytes is not used for integrity
description: The mock WFM serves a manifest with a wrong sizeBytes and correct digests. The device must still accept it.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: assign deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e06 in a manifest with a wrong sizeBytes
The device accepts the manifest and reports status for its new deployment
Mock WFM: restore the default desired state

name: Real device — a WFM the MIS did not certify is refused
description: For 50 seconds the mock WFM presents a certificate with its own SPIFFE ID that the MIS did not issue. The device must refuse the connection: it must not send any request over it. Afterwards the mock WFM presents its SVID again and the device continues.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: present a certificate the MIS did not issue for 50 seconds
The device sends no request to a WFM whose certificate the MIS did not issue

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not try to connect while the mock WFM presented the untrusted certificate

steps.name: The device continues when the WFM presents its SVID again

name: Real device — TLS versions and cipher suites RFC 9325 forbids are refused
description: For 50 seconds the mock WFM offers only TLS 1.0/1.1, then for 50 seconds only TLS 1.2 with RC4 cipher suites. The device must not complete a connection in either window. Each window is judged only when the device tried to connect in it; the RC4 window only when the device offered TLS 1.2.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
Mock WFM: offer only TLS 1.0 and 1.1 for 50 seconds
The device sends no request over TLS 1.0 or 1.1

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not try to connect while the mock WFM offered only TLS 1.0/1.1

steps.name: The device continues when the WFM offers TLS 1.2 and 1.3 again
Mock WFM: offer only TLS 1.2 with RC4 cipher suites for 50 seconds
Over TLS 1.2 the device refuses RC4 cipher suites (RFC 9325)

observe.only_if_reason: the device did not offer TLS 1.2 while the mock WFM offered only TLS 1.2 with RC4 (no TLS 1.2 fallback to judge)

steps.name: The device continues when the WFM offers TLS 1.2 and 1.3 again

name: Real device — state survives a restart
description: The operator restarts the device during this scenario. After the restart the device must still know the manifest it adopted (it sends its ETag) and must still reject a manifest version that does not increase. Reported as SKIP when the device is not restarted.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
The operator restarts the device (it reports its capabilities again)

observe.skip_reason: the device was not restarted during the run
observe.instruct: Restart the device under test now (within 3 minutes). To also test SVID rotation, replace its SVID with a re-issued one for the same SPIFFE ID before starting it.

steps.name: After the restart the device still sends the ETag of the manifest it adopted
Mock WFM: assign deployment 5f0c1c1e-2b7a-4c58-9d3e-1a2b3c4d5e07 in a manifest whose version does not increase
After the restart the device still rejects a manifest version that does not increase
Mock WFM: restore the default desired state

name: Real device — access continues after SVID rotation
description: When the device's SVID is replaced by a re-issued one for the same SPIFFE ID, the device keeps working without registering again. Reported as SKIP when the SVID was not replaced during the run.

steps.name: The device is connected to the mock WFM
The device presents a re-issued SVID for the same SPIFFE ID and its requests are accepted

observe.skip_reason: the device's SVID was not replaced during the run
